facts.fact: The World Bank diagnostic, prepared in September 2015 with the Department of Civil and National Registration of the Ministry of Labour and Home Affairs, states that the department runs civil registration and the national identity system through 37 offices in 12 districts and 25 subdistricts and 13 on-site registration offices at hospitals.

The World Bank diagnostic, prepared in September 2015, sets out as the way forward a 2015-2020 CRVS and Identity Management Investment Plan; the captured excerpt gives the plan's title only, not its content.

systems.owner: Department of Civil and National Registration, Ministry of Labour and Home Affairs
systems.tiers: 37 offices in 12 districts and 25 subdistricts; 13 on-site registration offices at hospitals

systems.owner: Department of Civil and National Registration, Ministry of Labour and Home Affairs
systems.tiers: national; interfaced with the electoral system, SOBERS, government payroll and the transport system

systems.system: link between birth and death registration and the National Identity Management System
systems.owner: Department of Civil and National Registration
systems.tiers: the identity number is issued on birth registration and used for the identity card at 16; the identity system is updated in real time when a death occurs, status changing from Live to Deceased
